description:
Dated changes in the register: rules that recently came into force and upcoming changes, sorted by date.

    Args:
        sector: "vente-en-ligne", "immobilier" or "entreprise"; all rules when omitted.
        since: first date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 90 days ago).
        until: last date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: no limit).
name: list_deadlines
